scope: Diagnostic RSS timings are perturbed by ps. Retained RSS after drop does not prove live allocations or a memory leak. Both workloads use the same dense input.

one.scope: One process, fixed public input shapes. End-to-end covers receipt creation (run plus independent check), in-memory JSON serialization, and verification (fresh run plus check); excludes CLI process startup, filesystem/network I/O, rendering, and deallocation after each sample. p50 is median, p95 nearest rank. Full experiments are included for reproduction. Dense service quotas are zero: it is a capacity probe, not a mission achievement. With memory_diagnostics enabled, ps probes on the first and last sample perturb total timing; those diagnostic timings are not throughput evidence.
